title: Research exploring customer views on the shift to digital post
text: The research aimed to explore how customers experience digital communications, what influences their decision to engage with them, and the factors that help build trust and confidence in digital messages. This insight into customer expectations, concerns and support needs has informed HM Revenue and Customs’ ( HMRC ’s) work on the design of digital correspondence. The research was conducted in February and March 2026 and comprised of 5 focus groups with individuals in employment, sole traders and small business owners.

attachments.title: Research to explore how customers experience and respond to the shift towards digital post under the modernisation of tax and customs administration
